facts.value: As part of your studies in another department, you can complete certain modules in our Department of Economics, known as export modules of the Department of Economics, including optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between departments.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For study programs of other departments, an overview is compiled indicating which export modules you can register in the Department of Economics and how you can incorporate these export modules into your study program in your department.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Furthermore, you cannot incorporate any other modules from the Department of Economics into your study program in the other department, nor can you earn differing credit points (CP) in the Department of Economics.
facts.programme_association: Double Degree Master's Program - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
